info.title: Create Target Collaboration
info.description:
This API is used to create a target collaboration.
A target collaboration is a collaboration between a seller selected set of products (including a commission payout) and a set of creators the seller has added (invited) to the collaboration. Target collaborations are private and not visible in the Creator Marketplace to all creators; they are only visible to those that have been added to the collaboration.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

name.description: The name of the target collaboration.

message.description: The message sent to creators associated with the target collaboration.

end_time.description: The date at which the target collaboration ends, in Unix epoch time.

target_commission_rate.description: The desired commission rate for the target collaboration. The desired commission rate is expressed in hundredths of a percent. For example, `3587` is a commission rate of `35.87%`. This value must a minimum of `100`.

shop_ads_commission_rate.description:
The commission rate applies only to orders generated from ads. If a creator’s video is used as an ad without this rate being set, the resulting orders will instead earn either:
- The Shop Ads commission you configured in open collaboration, or
- The standard commission defined in this invitation.
The commission rate is specified in increments of 1/10,000.
For example, 1000 stands for 0.1 or 10%.

products.description: A list of metadata and data for the products provided by the seller for target collaboration. Maximum length of the list is `100` products.

creator_user_open_ids.description: Maximum length of the list is `50` user open identifiers. Creator Open ID. [More details](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/3obfokj6)

phone_number.description: The phone number of the seller.

whatsapp.description: The phone number used by the seller to register for WhatsApp.

telegram.description: The  seller's Telegram username or phone number.

line.description: The phone number used by the seller to register for the Line app.

seller_contact_info.description: Metadata and data associated with the seller contact information.

has_free_sample.description: If set to `true`, free samples are provided to creators invited to the target collaboration group. If set to `false`, free samples are not provided.

is_sample_approval_exempt.description: If set to `true`, creators invited to the target collaboration are exempt from seller review and are automatically approved for a free  product sample. Note that the `has_free_sample` property overrides the free sample behavior.

free_sample_rule.description: A set of properties that control the free sample behavior for the product.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

target_collaboration_conflicts.description: A list of user and product identifiers with target collaboration conflicts that caused target collaboration failure.

invalid_open_id_list.description: The list of open id that caused the create to fail.

invalid_product_id_list.description: The list of product id that caused the create to fail.

create_time.description: The create time of the target collaboration.
